params.registrarAddress: The address of the DotRegistrarController contract.
params.registryAddress: The address of the ENS Registry contract.
params.storeFactoryAddress: The address of the StoreFactory contract.

registerAndStore((string,address,uint256.details: Performs two atomic operations: registers the name via DotRegistrarController and      records the registration in the user's store. The entire transaction reverts if any step fails.      The store must be deployed via StoreFactory and must have authorized this registrar contract.

params.registration: The registration parameters required by DotRegistrarController.
params.store: The address of the user's deployed store contract where the subdomain will be recorded.

registerSubdomainAndStore(string,string,.details: Performs two atomic operations: creates the subnode in ENS registry and records the subdomain      in the owner's store. The entire transaction reverts if any step fails.      The store must be deployed via StoreFactory and must have authorized this registrar contract.

params.owner: The address that will own the subdomain.
params.parentName: The parent domain name under which to create the subdomain.
params.resolver: The resolver address to set for the subdomain.
params.store: The address of the owner's deployed store contract where the subdomain will be recorded.

constructor.notice: Initializes the orchestrator with required contract addresses.

registerAndStore((string,address,uint256.notice: Register a new ENS name and automatically record it in the specified user store.

registerSubdomainAndStore(string,string,.notice: Create a subdomain under an existing domain and record it in the specified user store.
